en: An old sepia-toned postcard depicting a vast Jewish cemetery with many scattered tombstones and a few tall bare trees in the foreground. In the distance, a town and hills are visible. At the top there is printed multilingual text in Greek and French identifying the location as the Israelite (Jewish) cemetery of Salonique (Thessaloniki, Greece). There are handwritten notes and a postal cancellation mark, and a web watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.
